result_text:
I fixed the four broken default scoping conventions. The `codeanalyzer` module tests pass, but I added no new tests for these patterns and did not check the new matches directly.

- **`GeneratedConventions.java`:**
  - The pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules now use `(html|htm|xhtml)`. The old pattern listed `html` twice and left out `htm`.
  - The `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule and the .NET `<doc>` XML rule now use `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`. They used to require a file named exactly `.js` or `.xml`.
- **`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`:** the Gradle script rule is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. It used to require a literal `.-gradle.js`.

The old matches still hold: `.html` and `.xhtml` pages, and `build.gradle` through its separate `.*[.]gradle` rule. I only widened the filename patterns and left the content patterns alone, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files still fall outside these scopes.

I noticed that the neighbouring JS/CSS map rule on line 40, `.*/[.](css|js)[.]map`, has the same kind of typo. You didn't list it, so I left it alone.
